Own run at 1440x900 with deviceScaleFactor 2 on rift High, seed 41, teamfight with telegraphs, the size he did not measure: _harness/_shots/gfx_verify_GR2/report_1440.json, 1440_dpr*.png, sbs_1_1.25.png, sbs_1_1.5.png. So 1.25 costs about 50-77 MB and 1.5 about 140-164 MB at this size, more on 1512x982 and larger; with match readings up to 2983 MB under the 3.0 GB bar of ruling 20, either can break it on a peak match. Synced frame blocks: 10 / 10.7 / 12 ms at DPR 1, 10.5 / 11.7 / 14 at 1.25, 14.7 / 17.9 / 19.4 at 1.5, 9.2 / 8.9 / 8.9 back at 1, load 22-25: not_measured evidence, though the 1.5 step is large enough to read. Bars and outlines stay the same size in the crops. No step has been shown to hold 60 fps on an idle machine. No HUD capture, no calibrate test, no large HiDPI display (for example 2560x1440 logical) test exists.
